name: GKGRECORDID
description: Globally unique GKG record identifier combining the update timestamp and a within batch serial, potentially including T for translated documents.

name: DATE
description: Publication timestamp of the source document, formatted YYYYMMDDHHMMSS. For certain special collections, zero indicates an unknown or inapplicable date.

name: SourceCollectionIdentifier
description: Source collection type used to interpret DocumentIdentifier: 1 web, 2 citation only, 3 CORE, 4 DTIC, 5 JSTOR, 6 nontextual source.

name: SourceCommonName
description: Human readable name for the source, commonly a website domain or publishing institution.

name: DocumentIdentifier
description: External identifier for the source document, including URL, citation, or repository DOI.

name: Counts
description: Semicolon separated quantitative references extracted from the document, with count components separated by hash characters.

name: V2Counts
description: Counts enriched with approximate character offsets of each reference in the source document.

name: Themes
description: Semicolon separated codes for GDELT themes detected within the document.

name: V2Themes
description: Semicolon separated theme mentions paired with approximate character offsets, separated within each pair by commas.

name: Locations
description: Semicolon separated geographic references including location type, place name, country codes, coordinates, and feature identifier.

name: V2Locations
description: Geographic mentions with expanded administrative codes and approximate character offsets; repeated mentions can appear multiple times.

name: Persons
description: Semicolon separated person names detected in the text.

name: V2Persons
description: Person names paired with approximate character offsets in the source text.

name: Organizations
description: Semicolon separated company and organization names recognized within the document.

name: V2Organizations
description: Organization names paired with approximate character offsets in the source text.

name: V2Tone
description: Comma separated document tone measurements: overall tone, positive score, negative score, polarity, activity density, self or group reference density, and word count.

name: Dates
description: Semicolon separated date mentions with resolution, month, day, year, and character offset.

name: GCAM
description: Comma separated Global Content Analysis Measures scores, stored as dictionary dimension keys and numeric values; includes word count.

name: SharingImage
description: URL of the image designated by the news outlet for sharing the article, when available.

name: RelatedImages
description: Semicolon separated URLs of images assessed as relevant to the story.

name: SocialImageEmbeds
description: Semicolon separated URLs of embedded social media posts containing images.

name: SocialVideoEmbeds
description: Semicolon separated URLs of videos embedded within the source article.

name: Quotations
description: Extracted quotations encoded as structured blocks with character offset, length, introductory verb, and quoted text.

name: AllNames
description: Recognized proper names of people, events, laws, initiatives and other named subjects, with approximate character offsets.

name: Amounts
description: Quantitative amounts found in the text, including numeric value, referenced object, and approximate character offset.

name: TranslationInfo
description: Machine translation provenance, including original language code and translation engine citation; normally blank for English originals.

name: Extras
description: Optional XML encoded details for specialized collections; typically blank for ordinary news content.

name: ingested_at
description: UTC timestamp when the ingestion pipeline loaded this GKG record into BigQuery. Added for this project; not in the native GDELT GKG feed.

name: hour_time
description: UTC hour of the GDELT source batch
